<h1>Enquiries</h1>
<p><a class="arrow-down" href="contact#content">Arrow Down</a></p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="content" class="taipan-contentpanel-panel ">
  <div class="panel-background-image" ></div>
  <div class="panel-constrain">
    <div class="panel-block">
      <div class="panel-cell">
<h2>To make a booking with us, simply fill out the enquiry form and we will get back to you within a day.</h2>
<p>Given that Haggerstone Island only caters to a small number of people at a time, we often have limited availability. With this being the case we have implemented reduced deposit amounts for guests who wish to make bookings some time in advance.</p>
<p>In the panel below and to the left you will find a calendar which give an indication of when we are full and when we have availability. If the dates of interest are shaded in green then there is availability for at least two people. Please send through an enquiry using the form to the right if you would like any more information.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
